title: Zehren and Associates
description: zehren.com Zehren and Associates Zehren & Associates is an architecture and design firm founded in 1983 in Avon, Colorado, specializing in resort and mountain architecture with a second office in Santa Barbara, California. Led by founder Jack Zehren, a West Point graduate, the firm has about 37 employees and revenue of roughly 5 million dollars. It offers a full package of architecture, master planning, interior design and landscape architecture, known for projects like The 10th restaurant on Vail Mountain and The Blake hotel at Taos Ski Valley, voted the best ski hotel in North America. The firm designed the Beaver Creek master plan, winner of the Snow Country Best Resort award, and has worked in over 9 countries including Argentina, Korea and Mexico. Key strengths are 43 years of niche expertise and long-term partnerships with Vail Resorts and East West Partners.
